output_text: P2P baby monitor web app (WebRTC via PeerJS), Vite+TS. Two modes: Baby Station streams camera/mic; Parent Station receives stream, audio/motion meters, alerts. Module structure: each station self-contained with `init*` returning `CleanupHandle`. Cleanup pattern: all stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown. Tests: colocated `*.test.ts` use Vitest globals; Playwright e2e in `tests/` excluded via `vite.config.ts` (no separate `vitest.config`; test config embedded). Error handling: use `querySelectorOrThrow()`—never silently fail on missing DOM; never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`). URL state sync via params (`station`, `roomId`). Wake Lock: always request on station init, release in cleanup. Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup. Don’t hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room). Room
